sys_atf_test.name: Day-2 negative: privileged grant without expiry fails preflight (least privilege)
sys_atf_test.description: A privileged group/role grant carrying no expiry must be refused by pre-flight (AC-6), regardless of a valid approver.

sys_atf_step.description: Distinct requester/approver, privileged = true, NO expiry; assert refusal on least-privilege grounds.
The same request WITH an expiry now passes - proving the gate refuses the missing expiry, not the privileged flag itself.
